summary: End-to-end verified the StoneEditDialog refactor across all 3 caller pages (/dashboard/jobs, /dashboard/stones, /dashboard/shipments). Canonical component at /app/frontend/src/components/dialogs/StoneEditDialog.tsx renders identically across all surfaces. Original parcel-on-stones-page bug (regression that prompted the consolidation) confirmed FIXED. Shipments page now exposes Color Stability + Mounted toggles for admins as intended. All testids preserved.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' fires repeatedly (warning, not error) — Radix DialogContent expects either an explicit DialogDescription or aria-describedby. The new component DOES render <DialogDescription> with job# + type + weight, so the warning likely originates from a separate parent dialog (JobDetailDialog / shipments wrappers) without DialogDescription. Cosmetic but pollutes console.

critical_code_review_comments: Clean refactor — 421-line canonical component, pure presentational, props in / callbacks out. Hook ownership stays in parent pages which is correct because save handlers call into different stonesApi methods per page. No prop-drilling abuse.

Parcel fee multiplication math (csFeeCost * stone_count) implemented inline in StoneEditDialog.tsx:165 — both the live preview (Fee pill) and the inline CS line ('+$50 × 4 = $200') update in sync. Single source of truth for this math; no chance of drift between pages now.
shouldShowToggleStrip on line 174 correctly hides the CS/Mounted strip on read-only mode when both are false — keeps the dialog compact for stones without any fee surcharges. Good UX.

Stones-page Save button position (test ran on parcel SA750J58402, /dashboard/stones): rendered at footer bottom-right (x=1243 in 1920-wide viewport) — matches the harmonization goal stated in the problem statement.

Minor: setColorStability! / setMounted! non-null assertions on lines 276/301 are guarded by hasFeeToggles check above, but a Pick<>-style discriminated-union prop type would be cleaner than runtime + bang operators.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 11 acceptance criteria from review_request validated

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stone rows inside JobDetailDialog and ShipmentDetailDialog do NOT have data-testid='stone-row-*'; they're plain <TableRow> elements with onClick={() => openStoneDialog(stone)}. To select them in playwright use: 'querySelectorAll("[role=dialog] tbody tr")' and pick by visible SKU/parcel text. Shipments page uses cards, NOT a table, so 'tbody tr' returns 0 — use 'cursor-pointer' divs or text selectors. Login flow: blank TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY → fetch /api/auth/login → seed sessionStorage 'token' + 'auth-storage' JSON.
rca_of_the_issue: VERIFICATION (not a bug fix): Pre-refactor /dashboard/stones had its own StoneEditDialog copy that PREDATED the parcel feature, so opening a parcel-kind stone on /dashboard/stones did not show the 'Parcel · N stones' chip nor multiply CS fee by stone_count — silent regression caused by code drift across 3 inline copies. The Feb 25 2026 consolidation lifted the jobs-page version (richest) into /components/dialogs/StoneEditDialog.tsx and migrated all 3 callers. POST-FIX VERIFIED: On /dashboard/stones, clicking parcel SA750J58402 now correctly renders 'PARCEL 3 stones' chip + 'TOTAL WT / TOTAL VALUE' labels, and the edit-mode CS toggle shows '+$50 × 3 = $150' preview. On /dashboard/shipments, the Edit button + CS/Mounted toggles (previously gated out in the shipments-local copy) are now visible to admin and the canonical save handler persists via stonesApi.updateFees.
